title: Report an App Event
content_data:
Use this endpoint to report a mobile (i.e. Android/iOS) app event (e.g. Launch APP, Purchase) to TikTok. > **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path| /v1.2/app/track/| /v1.3/app/track/| |Request parameter data type|`tiktok_app_id`: number
`campaign_id` (in Context object): number
`ad_id` (in Context object): number
`creative_id` (in Context object): number |`tiktok_app_id`: string
`campaign_id` (in Context object): string
`ad_id` (in Context object): string
`creative_id` (in Context object): string | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/app/track/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Desciption| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized Access Token. It can be obtained through the
["Get Access token"](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162) interface. | |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `"application/json"`.| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |tiktok_app_id {Required}|string|TikTok App ID.
A TikTok App ID is a unique code that is generated in TikTok Ads Manager. An advertiser can bind multiple TikTok App IDs to the same mobile app. To learn about how to generate a TikTok App ID, see [TikTok App ID](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=10001060).| |event |string|App event name. Examples: `INSTALLAPP`, `PURCHASE`. For supported app events, see the Event name for event data connection column in the tables on the [Supported event types](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739585574120449).| |timestamp |string|Timestamp with ISO 8601 format. See [wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).| |context {Required}|object|Information about ad data connection in JSON format. For data fields in this object, see the Context object section below.| |properties |object|Properties associated with the event in JSON format. For data fields in this object, see the Properties object section.| ``` ### Context object ```xtable |Field{35%}|Data Type{10%}|Description{50%}| |---|---|---| |context {Required}|object|Information about ad data connection in JSON format.| #|app {Required}|object|Details about the app to report the event.| ##|id {Required}|string|Mobile App ID.
Examples (bold section) are, App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/angry-birds/id343200656;
Google Play：https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rovio.angrybirds.
If it is an Android app not in Google Play store, please use the package name.| ##|name |string|Application name.| ##|namespace |string|Android package name or iOS Bundle ID. Example: com.rovio.baba.| ##|version |string|App version number. For example, 3.0.2.| ##|build |string|App build number. For example, 122.| #|device |object|Data used to report device-level data to match users. idfa/idfv/advertising_id are required so long as they are obtainable. iOS：idfa/idfv; Android：advertising_id.| ##|platform |string|Operating system of user’s device; currently only accepting iOS/Android.| ##|idfa |string|iOS idfa. For iOS14+, please ensure iDFA data collection follows [Apple’s policies](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/user-privacy-and-data-use/).
Both raw and SHA-256 IDFA are accepted, but please note that:
  • For raw IDFA, all characters must be UPPERCASE. For SHA-256 IDFA, all characters must be lowercase. Examples:
    • Raw IDFA: "EA7583CD-A667-48BC-B806-42ECB2B48606"
    • SHA-256 IDFA: "70574fa9c8f498a7b2e5c8712b1126de7b1406fd02fdc591821c5bd33092fd1c"
  • Leading/trailing spaces need to be trimmed before hashing.
| ##|idfv |string|iOS idfv.| ##|gaid |string|Google Advertising ID.
Both raw and SHA-256 GAID are accepted, but please note that:
  • For both raw and SHA-256 GAID, all characters must be lowercase. Examples:
    • Raw GAID: "aaaaaa-2222-1111-8787-809e92233ba0"
    • SHA-256 GAID: "0ebad966881e1eebffe69b3abf624631cf83ec9bf8cb3ce134c7c75c6d8ee7fc"
  • Leading/trailing spaces need to be trimmed before hashing.
| ##|att_status |string|Whether the user has authorized your mobile app to access app-related data for measuring the user or the device. This is an iOS only field. Values:
  • `AUTHORIZED`: The user has authorized access to app-related data that can be used for measuring the user or the device.
  • `DENIED`: The user didn't agree to authorize your mobile app to access app-related data for measuring the user or the device via [Apple's AppTrackingTransparency framework](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/apptrackingtransparency). If set to this value, TikTok will not use the PII data (e.g. User email/phone number) in this app event for user-level matching.
  • `NOT_DETERMINED`: The user has not yet received an authorization request to authorize access to app-related data that can be used for measuring the user or the device.
  • `RESTRICTED`: The authorization to access app-related data is restricted.
  • `NOT_APPLICABLE`: The iOS version is below 14 or the device is running Android.
    • | #|locale |string|Examples：zh-CN、en-US. For reference, see [the IETF BCP 47 standardized code](https://tools.ietf.org/rfc/bcp/bcp47.txt).| #|ip |string|User IP.| #|user_agent |string|User agent from the user’s device. Example: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 11_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/604.1.38 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/11.0 Mobile/15A372 Safari/604.1.| #|user |object|The personal data of the user.| ##|external_id |string|The external user ID.
    It must be hashed with SHA256 on the client side. Leading/Trailing spaces need to be trimmed before hashing.| ##|phone_number |string| User's phone number.
    It must be hashed with SHA256 on the client side.
    Please include country code and format it based on the following rules:
    If the country code is 86, then do not include country code (example: 13800000000). Otherwise, include country code with + and remove any other characters (spaces, '-') between numbers (example for US: +12133734253)
    Hash the code with SHA256. Reference documents: https://github.com/google/libphonenumber.| ##|email |string|User's email.
    It must be hashed with SHA256 on the client side. You should first lowcase all the characters and then do hash.| #|library |object|SDK version info.| ##|name |string|Version number in string. Example: bytedance/tiktok-business-android-sdk.| ##|version |string|Version numer. Example: 1.2.0.| #|ori_attribution_partner|string|If the event is attributed by Mobile Measurement Partner to another platform, use this field to specify the platform name. Example: Facebook, Google.| #|ad|object|Ad information| ##|callback|string|Callback information to help attribute events.| ##|campaign_id|string|Campaign ID.| ##|ad_id|string| Ad group ID.| ##|creative_id|string|Ad ID.| ##|isRetargeting|boolean|Whether the user is a retargeting user.| ##|attributed|boolean|Whether the event is attributed.| ##|attributionType|string|Attribution type.| ##|attribution_provider|string|Attributed provider.| #|location|object|User's location information.| ##|country|string|Country or region.| ##|city|string|City.| ``` ### Properties object Properties associated with the event in JSON format. Some properties may only be associated with certain app events. See schema below. ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |properties |object|Properties associated with the event in JSON format.| #|contents |object[]|Related items in an app event (e.g. items purchased in a Purchase event).| ##|price |double|Price of item.| ##|quantity |number|Number of item.| ##|content_type |string|Type of the product item. This can be a description of the product item (e.g. being purchased).| ##|content_id |string|ID of the product item in your system.| ##|brand|string| Brand name of the product item.| #|currency |string|ISO 4217 code. Examples: "EUR", "USD", "JPY".| #|value |double|Total value of the order or items sold.| #|description |string|A string description of the app event.| #|query |string|The text string that was searched for.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/app/track/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --data-raw \ '{ "tiktok_app_id": "{{TIKTOK-APP-ID}}", "event":"AddToCart", "timestamp":"2023-09-17T19:49:27Z", "context":{ "app":{ "id":"1211123727", "name":"Angry Birds Classic", "namespace":"com.rovio.baba", "version":"3.0.2", "build":"122" }, "device":{ "att_status":"AUTHORIZED", "platform":"iOS", "idfa":"30255BCE-4CDA-4F62-91DC-4758FDFF8512" }, "locale":"zh-CN", "user":{ "email":"12346a405862e402eb76a70f8a26fc732d07c32931e9fae9ab1582911d2e8a3b", "phone_number":"12346a405862e402eb76a70f8a26fc732d07c32931e9fae9ab1582911d2e8a3b" }, "library":{ "name":"1.1.0-alpha.1", "version":"2" }, "ad":{ "callback":"E.C.P.ExampleCallback", "isRetargeting":false, "campaign_id":"1700817380525057", "attributed":true, "ad_id":"1700817380806706", "attributionType":"click_through", "creative_id":"1700817378256945", "attribution_provider":"mmp" } }, "properties":{ "currency":"USD", "value":10, "contents": [ { "quantity":5, "price":9.9 } ] } }' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The return code. For details, see [Appendix-Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|The return message. For details, see [Appendix-Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |request_id |string|The unique ID of the request. | |data|object|Returned data.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "request_id": "2019091810032301011023224213558" } (/code); ```
